applicationFee.note: Limited opportunities each admission cycle; inquire through the CAS inquiry form. Eligibility and approval not guaranteed.

english.toefl: 2026 policy: 85 overall; R21 L15 S24 W25
english.note: 2026 policy: Duolingo 115; IELTS 6.5 overall; R6.5 L6 S7.5 W6.5; 2026 policy also lists Cambridge 185/169 per skill and PTE 68/53 per band (PTE accepted beginning 2027). Alternative routes include qualifying English-speaking citizenship/permanent residence, qualifying bachelor's study, or two consecutive years of qualifying recent study/work; country, instruction and physical-presence conditions apply. Teaching assistants may need further assessment. Recheck the linked 2027 policy.

funding.note: Twelve months of financial support through teaching/research assistantships and fellowships. Satisfactory-progress students normally supported until degree completion.
